target_customer: Engineering teams with high traffic fetch APIs that want caching without rewriting code
problem: Caching APIs correctly takes months of engineering to handle invalidation. SuperAPI sits in front of APIs and invalidates cache entries by watching writes and database changes.
business_model: Usage-based developer infrastructure subscription with pricing page

founders.name: Adithya Kavuluru
prior_employers: Unnamed Tiger Global backed Indian tech company
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was the first engineer and later led engineering that grew from 6 to about 55 people.

founders.name: Aditya
prior_employers: Unnamed Tiger Global backed Indian tech company
founders.background_notes: YC page says he headed platform engineering and brought API latencies under 50 ms. Last name not given on the page; an aggregator says Agrawal, unverified.

technical_complexity.rationale: Correct automatic invalidation through change data capture and request monitoring is hard but done on top of existing CDNs and databases.

defensibility.rationale: Sits in the request path of customer APIs which creates some stickiness, but CDN vendors and gateways can add caching features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The company explicitly runs on top of Cloudflare and CloudFront rather than competing with them. No copying or acquisition found.

market_need_then: Founders cite scaling API latency at their prior company. No dated third party source on demand was found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Terse and metric driven: 10x faster APIs, zero engineering effort

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with other products and no press about the brand found.

outcome_analysis: SuperAPI remains a two person YC W23 team with a live website showing a 2026 copyright and a pricing page. No funding beyond YC is confirmed, no customers are named, and no exit or shutdown was found, so the outcome is unclear and traction cannot be rated.
notes: Funding unverified: CB Insights says $500K over two rounds including a convertible note dated 2023-01-01; PitchBook and extruct list a pre-seed in April or May 2023 with Y Combinator, Other People's Capital and Relentless VC. Aggregators only, with conflicting instrument types, so no round recorded. YC page lists Chennai while others say Bengaluru. CB Insights names a second founder Vishnu Vinjam which conflicts with the YC launch post; not recorded. No dated competitor sources near early 2023 were found (the Fastly page says Stellate ran on Fastly from November 2023), so the competitor list is empty.
